title: Marvell Proposes Acquiring Lumentum to Combine Optical Circuit Switching with AI Connectivity Silicon
gist: Marvell has agreed to acquire Lumentum in an all-stock deal valued at about $115 billion, combining its electrical/optical interconnect and custom silicon with Lumentum's InP lasers, compound semiconductor fabs and MEMS-based optical circuit switching. The thesis is that AI connectivity is the next bottleneck as the copper wall approaches, but the deal is effectively a merger (67/33 ownership) and is not expected to close until 1H 2028.
